GzFastWriter: forward-only gzip writer over the bundled zlib deflater.

Imports

config, errors, report, private/zlib_api, private/writer_accounting

Types

GzFastWriter = ref object
Forward-only gzip writer. Not safe for concurrent calls from multiple threads.

Finish the gzip member and release owned resources. Idempotent. 
proc finish(w: GzFastWriter): GzipWriteReport {.
    ...raises: [IOError, GzFastError, Exception], tags: [WriteIOEffect],
    forbids: [].}

Finish the gzip member, write the trailer, and return deterministic stats.

The underlying file remains open; call close when using a writer that owns its file.

proc flush(w: GzFastWriter) {....raises: [IOError, GzFastError],
                              tags: [WriteIOEffect], forbids: [].}

Make compressed bytes written so far visible to the underlying file.

This uses zlib's sync flush and can reduce compression ratio when called frequently.

Open a gzip writer around an existing File.

When ownsOutput is true, close also closes output; otherwise the caller remains responsible for closing it.
